inner_split: 800000 training file row index modulo 5: 0 validation, others train
encoding: 16 values per block, uint16 base plus 10-bit differences, 1023 denotes INF
model: premerged V6 features plus four long-distance categorical residual groups
implementation: compact residual tables, read-only mmap with MAP_POPULATE, portable x86-64, single thread
limits: Global physical shortest paths are not guaranteed. The architecture-derived local table and long-distance regression are approximations. No billion-request benchmark was run.
